description: Defines a Flutter widget 'TopHeadlineCard' for displaying news headlines with an image and text, and a helper widget '_HeroImage' for loading images with placeholders and error handling.

classes.name: TopHeadlineCard
classes.description: A stateless widget displaying a news article as a card with image and headline.

classes.name: _HeroImage
classes.description: A private stateless widget that displays an image from a URL with placeholder and error handling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for TopHeadlineCard and _HeroImage.

methods.name: _HeroImage.build
methods.description: Constructs the image widget, either a CachedNetworkImage or a placeholder/error widget if URL is invalid.

calls: CachedNetworkImage(imageUrl: url!, fit: BoxFit.cover, placeholder: _, errorWidget: _)
